title: Seakart Adventure SC
specs: Only Seakart experience of its kind in the U.S.
Guided route through scenic marshlands, creeks, and open ocean when weather permits
Drivers must be 18+ with a valid driver's license
Riders must be at least 6 years old
Each Seakart has a total weight limit of 500 lbs
Guests may not participate if under influence of drugs or alcohol, cannot swim, or have medical conditions including pregnancy
All other shoes must be stored in the lockers provided at the dock.
South Carolina Law requires a life jacket, which will be provided and must be worn at all times while underway.
Cancellation: Reservations must be cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the rental start time to receive full refund.
Each Seakart accommodates up to three people (one driver and two riders)

blurb: Guests drive their own Seakart, a stable hybrid watercraft combining jet ski speed with boat stability, on a guided route through marshlands, creeks, and open ocean when weather permits. Each adventure includes a professional safety briefing and is led by a dedicated lead boat for safety. The experience is suitable for drivers 18+ with a valid license and riders 6+ years old.
